claims.subject: SKILL_ACQUISITION_ON_FOURTH_SPECIAL_TRAINING
claims.finding: The user reports visible skill acquisitions on the fourth training, and roughly forty reset attempts on sessions 1-3 without acquisitions.
claims.sample_scope: User-supplied historical SAVE/LOAD experiment, not independent universally representative runs
unknowns: Whether count is player-specific, drill-specific or global
Whether screenshots represent independent positive rolls
claims.navigation_effect: Prefer fourth eligible committed session as a skill-roll checkpoint; do not repeatedly farm 1-3 based on this evidence, but don't promise a guaranteed skill.
